citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 9am on 7/22/2026.
The inspector arrived on the property and knocked on the door. The licensee’s wife answered the door and located the
licensee. The licensee stated that he was unavailable to conduct an inspection because his back was out. The licensed
was asked if anyone else could accompany the inspectors to complete the inspection and he said “No.” When asked who
was caring for the dogs, the licensee stated “The dogs are getting fed and watered and they were fine. There are some
other things that need done but the dogs are getting food and water.” The licensee has not provided access to the facility,
animals, and records for inspection as required by the Animal Welfare Act during three additional visits to the premises.
Failure to provide access to the facility, animals, and records for inspection is a violation of the AWA and regulations.
Continued failure to provide access is serious and may result in enforcement action.
Additional Inspectors:
William Janecke, VETERINARY MEDICAL OFFICER
Richard Burdeaux, VETERINARY MEDICAL OFFICEREnd Section
